tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Plain page background when there is no wallpaper or content under the glass.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Opaque grouped surfaces and the solid fallback for glass when transparency is reduced.

tokens.name: wall-base
tokens.usage: Base of the demo wallpaper (`lg-stage`) that sits under glass in previews and marketing shots.

tokens.name: wall-a
tokens.usage: Warm wallpaper blob. Decorative only, never under text without a glass layer.

tokens.name: wall-b
tokens.usage: Cool teal wallpaper blob. Decorative only.

tokens.name: wall-c
tokens.usage: Green wallpaper blob. Decorative only.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular glass: toolbars, tab bars, buttons and cards floating over content.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Thick glass for text-heavy layers: fields, menus, sheets, dialogs. Keeps `label` at 4.5:1 over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass over media (photos, video). Pair with a dimming layer; never put small text on it alone.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass: selected segment, active tab pill, focused field wash.

tokens.name: glass-rim-hi
tokens.usage: Specular top-left rim of every glass shape (the lit edge).

tokens.name: glass-rim-lo
tokens.usage: Shaded bottom-right rim of every glass shape.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on `bg`, `bg-elevated` and every glass fill.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, subtitles, metadata, on `bg-elevated` and `glass-fill-strong`.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels, on `glass-fill-strong` and `bg-elevated`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and menu groups. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Visible 1px outline of text fields, checkboxes and radios (3:1 on `bg-elevated`).

tokens.name: fill-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of switches, sliders and progress bars.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumb.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tint for links, selected checkmarks, active icons and accent text on any surface.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of prominent buttons, checked checkboxes, on switches and slider progress.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `accent-fill`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hovered and active menu rows, accent badge background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid field outline, destructive plain buttons.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive prominent buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-fill`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind dialogs and sheets.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Page title above content; collapses to `headline` in a scrolled NavBar.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Dialog titles, group headers in dense views.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Button labels in `lg` size, list row titles, NavBar title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text and large text-field values.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Field values, select triggers and menu rows at `md` size.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Button labels at `md`, field labels, segmented control labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Hints, errors, list subtitles, character counters.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Tab bar labels and tiny metadata.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and tokens in documentation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner horizontal padding of `sm` controls and menu rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of `md` fields and buttons; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and sheet padding on compact screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, tooltips, inner elements nested in a `radius-lg` shape.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text areas, list groups, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and popovers (outer shape; children use concentric `radius-sm`).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, large floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, search boxes, tab bars, segmented controls, switches: Liquid Glass controls are capsules.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass: buttons, fields, toolbars, cards.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating glass: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumbs.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radius for glass layers; combined with saturate(180%).

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: Clear glass over media.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: Buttons, toolbars, tab bars, cards.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: Menus, fields, dialogs: anything carrying reading text.

size.note: Control heights. Hit area never smaller than `touch-min`.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense toolbars and inline filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, field, select and search height on web.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary forms, mobile layouts, hero search.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; pad smaller controls up to this.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, listboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim and sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
